dataset.name: Metastatic bladder cancer (IMvigor210)
dataset.description: Independent phase II atezolizumab cohort with harmonized bulk RNA-seq and overall survival data.
dataset.cohort_context: Metastatic urothelial carcinoma; pretreatment biopsies from an immune-checkpoint inhibitor trial and therefore not interchangeable with an unselected primary-tumor cohort.
dataset.publication_citation: Rosenberg et al. ESMO Open 2024; original IMvigor210 report, Lancet 2016

metadata.curation_note: The source cohort is independent of TCGA. It is retained as a context-specific validation cohort rather than a population-matched BLCA replication set.

expression.label: iAtlas TPM profile (provided scale)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied gene symbol are averaged sample-wise. Distinct source identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: DataHub labels the matrix as TPM, but the supplied values are bounded near 22 and the exact upstream transform is not stated in the profile metadata. TCGA-TRACE preserves those values without applying a second transform and does not claim an unlogged TPM scale.
